memes: 'Grr Mondays' format: slapping '#GrrMondays' over chaotic Monday morning content, sourced from a rediscovered throwaway line in Ted 2 that took hold on TikTok in early September
Jon Hamm dancing through the pain: using the Your Friends & Neighbors club scene to represent performing happiness while everything is falling apart
Capybara of Indifference: pairing intensely dramatic audio with footage of a capybara that simply sits there, completely unbothered
Parent split-face trend: morphing your face with a parent's to reveal the resemblance, now expanded to couples, siblings, and even pets
'Patient Zero' Wedding Day Edit: brides and grooms soundtracking first-dance or proposal clips with Taylor Swift's new Celtic-pop single
